claims: A carriage dispute between DISH Network and Gray Media began on March 10, 2026.
The carriage dispute has resulted in the blackout of 226 local stations across 113 U.S. markets.
The blackout impacts ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, and other affiliates.
Gray Media claims DISH is making unreasonable demands.
DISH accuses Gray of demanding high fee increases.
As of mid-April 2026, the stations remain off the air.
Both sides accuse each other of failing to negotiate in good faith.
The blackout includes stations covering local news, weather, and sports.
DISH claims it is resisting high rate increases to prevent passing costs to consumers.
DISH states Gray pulled the stations.
Gray Media alleges that DISH rejected multiple extensions.
Gray Media alleges that DISH is demanding unprecedented contract terms.
Viewers lost access to major network programming.
Viewers lost access to local news.
Gray Media has advised users to watch their stations on other satellite or cable providers.
DISH suggests using over-the-air antennas to regain access to local, free-to-air channels.
